Cross & Parker
Gold-Tone Writing Instrument Set
Vintage, Late 20th Century
This executive writing set features two gold-tone instruments manufactured by Cross, presented in a vintage Parker hardshell case. Both the ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil showcase the slim, tapered profile and iconic conical tops characteristic of the Cross Classic Century line. While the instruments are branded Cross, the presentation case is an original Parker accessory, reflecting a mixed heritage common in estate collections.
Cross Ballpoint Pen: Gold-tone finish, "Cross" engraved on clip
Cross Mechanical Pencil: Matching gold-tone finish, "Cross" engraved on clip
Parker Case: Black hardshell with silver-tone logo and branded interior insert
Case Dimensions: 6.4" x 5.2" x 1"
Condition:

275394421.description:
Waterman Paris
Striped Lacquer Fountain Pen - Gold Trim
Late 20th Century, France
This Waterman Paris fountain pen exemplifies the elegant French design and reliable engineering that defined the brand's production after moving operations to France in the mid-20th century. Featuring a slim, sophisticated profile, the barrel and cap are finished in a dark lacquer with subtle vertical burgundy stripes, complemented by gold-tone accents and rings. The Waterman brand, established in 1884, is renowned for inventing the first functional fountain pen feed, a legacy of quality visible in this late vintage example.
Marked "WATERMAN MADE IN FRANCE" on the central gold-tone band
Gold-tone nib featuring the Waterman "W" logo and ornate scrollwork
Includes original blue Waterman Paris presentation box with white satin lining
Original user manual booklet and one blue ink cartridge included
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition. The pen body shows only very light surface micro-scratches consistent with careful storage and minimal use. The gold trim is bright and free of pitting or significant tarnish. The nib appears clean and well-maintained. The presentation box and paperwork are in very good condition with minor shelf wear to the outer casing.

274854093.description:
Natural Agate Geode
Polished Stone Bookends Pair
Natural Agate, Made in Brazil
4" Tall
Unsigned
This pair of natural agate geode bookends showcases the geological beauty of Brazilian stone. Each piece features a highly polished face revealing intricate banding patterns and macrocrystalline quartz interiors that capture and reflect light. The exterior retains the natural, rugged stone rind, providing a striking textural contrast between the raw earth and the refined, glossy display surfaces.
Unique natural banding and crystalline structures characteristic of Brazilian agate
Weight and density provide stable support for book collections or library displays
Original "Made in Brazil" label remains attached to the stone surface
Natural earth tones integrate seamlessly with Mid-Century Modern or Bohemian decor
Condition:
Very good condition overall with average wear. As is common with natural stone specimens, both pieces exhibit some small chips along the edges and rinds. The polished surfaces show minimal age-appropriate wear, and the structural integrity remains sound.
